units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 69:10">Targ. Ps. LXIX, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:7">Targ. Cant. I, 7</cite>.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8b:1-5">Ab. Zar. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>תלתין … עד דשַׁתְּפִינְהוּ לישראל בהדייהו</he> for thirty-two years did the Romans wage war with the Greeks, and could not conquer them, until they made Israel their allies.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 61:9">Yalk. ib. 61</cite> (the demon said to Noah) <he>שׁוּתְּפִי עמך וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>שִׁיתְּפִי</he>) I go into partnership with thee, but be careful &c. (v. <cite ref="U02131">preced.</cite>).

senses.gloss: to be joined, make an agreement, form a partnership.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 5:17">Targ. Prov. V, 17</cite>.
Targ. Y. Ex. XVI, 5 (v. preced. Hithpa.).—

<cite ref="Berakhot 29b">Ber. 29ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>לעולם לִישַּׁתֵּף נפשיה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לִשְׁתַּתֵּף</he>) man (in his prayer) should always include himself in the community (pray for all people in the same condition).

<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:3">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>מִשְׁתַּתַּפְנָא בפריטי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מִשְׁתַּתֵּיפְנָא</he>) I used to make myself a partner by contributing some money (towards the expense of the Ḥănuckah lights); a. e.
